note: Panes (docs/PLAYER_INTERFACE.md, slice 1; ui/play/pane_kit.gd, checked by tools/check_data.gd). On a desktop-sized window a panel opened over the open world is a pane: a window with a face, a border and a title bar that is dragged, raised when clicked and remembered where it was left (in settings.cfg, never the save). On a narrow window or a touch screen the same panel is the full-screen overlay it always was. `sizes` gives a panel its own size by the name of its script (without .gd); `default_size` is for the rest. A size is cut to the room the window has less `margin` on each side.
